notes.title: Update v1.1: Voices of Kawami
notes.content:
As Mohawkadour always says, [b]"Kawamian influencers will not be silenced!"[/b]

[b]One Night in Kawami[/b]'s first major update now brings [b]voice reactions for all four people[/b] Max interacts with during their night out in the City of Rivers - along with [b]two neat little surprises[/b] on the game's logo and title sequence...

(Or should we say [b]eight[/b] little surprises? This is brought to you by randomization!)

[list]
[*][url=https://www.jonnalynnalonso.com]Jonna-Lynn Alonso[/url] is [b]Tanya[/b]
[*][url=https://dashawnricks.carrd.co]Dashawn Ricks[/url] is [b]Gilbert[/b]
[*][url=https://linktr.ee/moyceover]Aaron Moy[/url] is [b]Mohawkadour[/b] (and the casting director for the game!)
[*][url=https://vanessabenoit.carrd.co]Vanessa Benoit[/url] is [b]Inga[/b]
[/list]

Update your game and find out how they sound like through short, non-verbal interactions ([i]mostly![/i]).
